title: SAT
subtitle: Digital SAT
description: Practice the Reading and Writing and Math sections. These samples are not adaptive and do not produce SAT scores.

topics.title: Reading and Writing
topics.description: Interpret short passages, revise sentences, and choose transitions.

questions.prompt: Choose the best transition: "Maya planned to bike to school. _____, heavy rain forced her to take the bus."
questions.explanation: However signals the contrast between Maya's plan and what happened.

questions.explanation: The subject each is singular, so it takes has.

questions.prompt: If 2x + y = 11 and y = 3, what is x?
questions.explanation: Replace y with 3: 2x + 3 = 11, so 2x = 8 and x = 4.
